name: 2,2-dimethoxypropane
description: 2,2-Dimethoxypropane (CAS 77-76-9 ), commonly known as DMP or acetone dimethyl acetal, is a reactive solvent and dehydrating agent used across pharmaceutical, biotech, and specialty chemical manufacturing. It functions primarily as a water scavenger and protecting group reagent, enabling moisture-sensitive reactions and synthesis steps that require controlled anhydrous conditions. In pharmaceutical synthesis, DMP protects carbonyl and hydroxyl groups during multi-step API manufacturing, reducing side reactions and improving yield consistency for manufacturers. Biotech and life sciences laboratories use it as a rapid chemical dehydrant for biological sample preparation, particularly in electron microscopy tissue processing where water removal must be precise. As a flavoring intermediate, acetone dimethyl acetal contributes to the production of certain aroma compounds where controlled acetal chemistry is required for the final product. It also functions as a solvent in reactions where conventional polar aprotic solvents are unsuitable due to moisture sensitivity. This makes it a versatile tool in complex chemical synthesis. 2,2-Dimethoxypropane is supplied as a clear liquid in standard drum and IBC quantities, with bulk availability for industrial-scale procurement. Technical grade is the most common commercial specification. High-purity grades are available to meet pharmaceutical and analytical laboratory requirements.
